description:
Hermes Agent is powerful, but the hard part is knowing what to actually give it.

In this video, I show the exact system I would use to set up Hermes Agent as a daily assistant. Instead of starting with random one-off prompts, I make Hermes interview me, audit my work, build a delegation map, choose the first three workflows, schedule a morning check-in, and turn repeated work into reusable skills.

The goal is not to automate your entire life on day one. The goal is to create a small daily loop where Hermes learns what matters, suggests useful work, handles the safe parts, and slowly becomes more personalized over time.

I also share the prompts I use so you can copy them into your own Hermes Agent.

Download the prompt pack here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/10HyMIwCdb8jEx_bU0VH53C14cPE_9zfG/view?usp=sharing
